title: Enterprise Education Platforms
subtitle: Professional engineering at New Generation Myanmar
description: Challenge: replace fragmented academic operations with consistent digital workflows. I contribute across training-management and student-information portals, translating domain rules into maintainable full-stack features, role-aware interfaces, and structured data flows.

title: MarkdownEditor
subtitle: Desktop Markdown editor
description: Architected a desktop editing workflow that keeps filesystem state, editor state, and a JavaFX WebView preview synchronized. The Swing application combines CommonMark/GFM rendering, undo-redo history, PDF export, and a packaged Windows installer.

title: BurmeseNLP
subtitle: Open-source Myanmar NLP toolkit
description: Designed a dependency-light, staged Myanmar-language pipeline with deterministic APIs for normalization, Zawgyi conversion, segmentation, POS tagging, phrase chunking, gazetteer NER, clause parsing, and corpus export. The library supports bundled and custom lexicons without requiring model downloads.

title: Laya Burmese SIB-200
subtitle: Calibrated Burmese topic classification
description: Fine-tuned a 0.3B-parameter multilingual Laya checkpoint on the Burmese SIB-200 split for typed seven-class topic decisions. Temperature scaling reduced calibration error to 0.051; on the official 204-example test split, the model reached 71.6% accuracy and 67.7% macro-F1 versus a 44.1% zero-shot baseline.

title: Learn Myanmar Script
subtitle: In-browser Burmese handwriting recognition
description: Co-developed an educational handwriting-recognition experience that runs ONNX inference directly in the browser. A canvas-based practice interface connects character drawing, reference forms, recognition feedback, and quiz workflows without requiring a server-side inference API.

title: Burmese POS Workbench
subtitle: XLM-R Myanmar POS tagging
description: Integrated BurmeseNLP word segmentation with an XLM-R token-classification model, a reusable Python wrapper, and a cached Streamlit inference interface. The model reports 97.24% accuracy on its in-domain holdout while remaining runnable on a local machine.

title: Krypto
subtitle: Secure desktop file encryption
description: Built a JavaFX security utility around AES-256 and ChaCha20 encryption workflows. The application coordinates file validation, password feedback, progress state, configurable output handling, searchable operation history, and CSV export behind a packaged desktop interface.

title: GEDSim
subtitle: AI-assisted assessment platform
description: Engineered an AI-assisted learning workflow that turns generated assessment content into practice tests and exam-style sessions. The product connects content generation, learner interaction, and structured mock-exam flows in a unified web experience.

title: MeetToTalk
subtitle: Meetup discovery and sharing
description: Developed a focused event-discovery product that reduces the path from finding a meetup to sharing and joining it. The system models event details, reusable public links, and lightweight coordination for community and spontaneous gatherings.

title: Service Management System
subtitle: Full-stack service management
description: Implemented a React client and Spring Boot service layer around the complete ticket lifecycle—from customer request intake to assignment, status transitions, and operational tracking. The separation of UI, API, and domain logic keeps workflow rules explicit and extensible.

title: EchoPost
subtitle: Full-stack social publishing system
description: Built an end-to-end publishing system for authenticated authors, posts, comments, and reactions. Laravel owns routing, persistence, authentication, and interaction rules, while InertiaJS connects the React interface without duplicating the application as a separate REST client.

title: LMS
subtitle: Learning Management System
description: Designed role-specific learning workflows across a React frontend and Java backend. Student and teacher dashboards separate concerns while sharing a consistent domain model for course activity, access, and academic operations.

title: Customer Churn Prediction
subtitle: ML-based churn risk dashboard
description: Connected dataset upload and validation to a Scikit-learn inference pipeline, then surfaced churn probabilities through a React dashboard. The implementation separates preprocessing, prediction, and visualization so model outputs remain traceable through the application flow.

title: ERP System
subtitle: Desktop ERP application
description: Contributed full-stack modules to a JavaFX and MySQL ERP system, including point-of-sale, payment, and unit-exchange workflows. The work required coordinating transactional business rules across desktop UI, application logic, and relational persistence.

title: DevAsk
subtitle: Q&A platform for developers
description: Implemented a relational developer Q&A system with Java EE and MySQL, modeling questions, answers, users, and discussion workflows. Bootstrap provides the presentation layer while server-side application logic coordinates validation and persistence.

title: Trash Trade
subtitle: CNN-powered recycling workflow
description: Designed a request-time computer-vision pipeline that preprocesses an uploaded image, runs CNN inference to classify the waste category, and returns the result through a Flask service. The prediction feeds a points-and-rewards workflow that connects model output to a practical recycling interaction.
